examples.label: Message box on a contact form
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-textarea-field" site="Global" id="textarea-contact-message" name="message" value="" label="Message" placeholder="Tell us what you are trying to build and where you are stuck." description="The more detail you give, the fewer questions we have to send back." rows="5" space="small" rounded="medium" />

examples.label: Product review box with writing guidance
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-textarea-field" site="Global" id="textarea-product-review" name="review_body" value="" label="Your review" placeholder="What did you like, and what would you change?" description="Reviews of 40 characters or more are published within one working day." rows="4" disable_resize variant="bordered" color="natural" space="small" rounded="medium" />

examples.label: Delivery note for the courier, with a floating label
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-textarea-field" site="Global" id="textarea-order-note-floating" name="courier_note" value="" label="Note for the courier" floating="outer" rows="3" disable_resize variant="bordered" color="primary" space="small" rounded="medium" />
